more_info.overview: Ascorbyl stearate is an ester combining ascorbic acid and stearic acid, also described as vitamin C stearate. Its antioxidant function is to slow oxidative deterioration during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
